# The Anti-Matrix Project

## Core Overview
The Anti-Matrix Project is a comprehensive control deck and dashboard for managing advanced AI agent systems, tracking missions, and monitoring infrastructure. It serves as a unified portal for operational intelligence, threat monitoring, and system diagnostics.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://theantimatrixproject.com/): Primary dashboard and project portal.
- [Control Deck](https://theantimatrixproject.com/control-deck): Advanced mission control interface for managing agents, databases, and system infrastructure.
